## What does this pull request change? ✏️

<!-- One or two sentences. Example: "Corrects the description of revocation in Lesson 2." -->

## Type of change

- [ ] 📝 Content correction (facts, sources, examples)
- [ ] 🇬🇧 Language (British English, clarity, inclusive wording)
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility (alt text, structure, contrast)
- [ ] 🧩 New or changed exercise or quiz
- [ ] 🖼️ Images or graphics

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is in British English (e.g. *recognise*, *organisation*, *licence*, *per cent*).
- [ ] Sources are named and current; the date in the header (`version`) and in `CHANGELOG.md` is updated.
- [ ] Every quiz still has exactly one correct answer `[(X)]` and feedback for each option.
- [ ] Images have meaningful alt text and their rights are cleared (see `LICENCE-NOTICE.md`).
- [ ] ICoBC logos and the ICoBC name are used only as agreed with ICoBC.
- [ ] The automatic check (GitHub Actions) is green.
